<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates whose forward reaction breaks a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group and forms a C‑C double bond, matching the Peterson elimination for the given stilbene target.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
